// P-FLOW-01 RED fixture: a wf_history row carrying an inline-PII result body with NO
// #[personal_data(...)] tag — the un-erasable-subject bug class the no-untagged-personal-data lint
// exists to kill. The flow engine is references-not-payloads, so the rare inline-PII result MUST be
// envelope-encrypted + tagged (the result_key_ref crypto-shred lever); an untagged inline body
// leaves an un-erasable subject. NOT real crate code (lives under /fixtures/, excluded from the
// live lint-gate).
pub struct WfHistoryRow {
    pub tenant_id: String,
    pub region: String,
    pub message_body: String,
}
